one_line: Anthropic targets a massive IPO and valuation, while Nvidia faces leadership and export scrutiny following Jensen Huang's resignation.

themes.title: Anthropic targets massive IPO and valuation
themes.text: Anthropic is targeting up to $90.4 billion in an IPO and private placement with a fully diluted valuation of roughly $1.4 trillion, while testing its public benefit corporation governance.

stories.headline: Anthropic targets up to $90.4B in IPO and private placement

themes.title: Nvidia leadership and export controls under scrutiny
themes.text: Allies and industry figures are lobbying for Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO following his resignation over a probe, while U.S. lawmakers push for stricter export controls.
